name: Minerals & Gemstones
description: Factual visual research methodology for minerals and gem materials.

exclude: composition, framing, camera, lens, style, mood, background, lighting setup and shot design

questions.question: Determine material identity, classification, diagnostic features, scale and locality-related variation where established.
Describe crystal habit, aggregate structure, matrix or host material where visually relevant.

sections.title: Appearance and behaviour
sections.description: Describe observable colour, surface and optical behaviour.

questions.question: Describe colour, variation, zoning, transparency, luster, cleavage, fracture, inclusions and natural imperfections.
Describe raw, broken, sawn, polished, cabochon and faceted appearance where applicable.
Describe observable behaviour under transmitted, back, raking and diffuse light without prescribing a lighting setup.
Record treatments, look-alikes, misconceptions, factual generation risks and conflicting descriptions.
